versions.changelog: Improved skill descriptions: better triggering for HLSL/shaders, Spreads/collections, ImportAsIs/dotnet, VL packages, reactive channels. Fixed broken cross-skill reference in troubleshooting.

- Initial release: vvvv gamma troubleshooting guide for C# nodes, SDSL shaders, and runtime issues.
- Covers common causes and fixes for node naming, parameter order, node browser visibility, and allocation/performance issues.
- Includes runtime topics: memory leaks, thread safety, circular dependencies, and build problems.
- Provides troubleshooting tips for shader compilation and correct project setup.
- References detailed error solutions via linked documentation.
